messages:
maya_cs: AlderFin private deploy went live ~2h ago. Quick health check: networking looks green from our side, but two blockers: KMS rotation not enabled (policy error) and audit logs failing to ingest into their Splunk. This is a potential renewal risk if it drags. looping in @sam_eng and @nora_sre for infra help.

sam_eng: On it. Can you paste a sample error from the log stream?

maya_cs: Sample from their agent: ```ERROR 2026-05-12T14:03:02Z audit-forwarder: 403 KMS: access denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345```

maya_cs: And from the Splunk side: ```POST /services/collector/event 400 Bad Request - invalid timestamp: 0000-00-00T00:00:00Z```

nora_sre: Quick look — egress firewall is dropping requests to the customer's Splunk ingest IP range. I'll open an exception request with infra. @devin_se can you confirm the KMS key policy?

devin_se: Confirmed: key policy doesn't include the customer's cross-account role ARN. We'll need them to add `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/AlderFin-Redwood` as a principal or we add a service principal mapping. Sample command they can run: `aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name AlderFin-Redwood --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSKeyManagementServicePowerUser`

kevin_customer: Hey team — we ran a role attach earlier but I might have used the wrong account id. I'm attaching the right role now; should be done in ~30m.

sam_eng: Thx. Pushed a temporary fallback: audit events will buffer to an S3 bucket in their account so we don't drop events during the fix. I deployed a small lambda forwarder to replay once splunk is reachable. Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/audit/alderfin (restricted)

maya_cs: Appreciate that. Can we get KMS rotation and Splunk ingestion fully recovered within 24h? Renewal touchpoint next Tue; would like a clean health slide.

nora_sre: I created INFRA-5123 to approve egress exception, flagged as P1 and pinged network oncall. ETA EOD.

devin_se: Plan: once role is attached I will update the key policy, perform a staged rotation (rotate -> re-encrypt recent objects -> verify signatures), then validate ingestion. I will post command outputs and checksum.

sam_eng: Running smoke test after fallback. `curl -X POST https://splunk.example.com/services/collector -d '{"event":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Splunk token'` -> `200 OK` from our forwarder. Will monitor for 10m.

kevin_customer: Role is attached and I confirmed the account id. Tell me if you need any extra permissions on our side.

maya_cs: Action items recap: Nora = approve firewall exception, Devin = update & rotate KMS policy, Sam = validate ingestion + replay buffer, Kevin = confirm role (done). Scheduling a 15m recap at 16:00 PT to confirm health for renewal deck. Thanks all :party_parrot:

onboard_bot: Reminder: AlderFin renewal health score updated -> 74 (watchlist). Please update thread when resolved.
